top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §747.501(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to maintaining and administering unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §747.4401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two year old children were observed using a dome climber play equipment that is for ages 3-10 years of age.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §747.4605(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The use zone for the slide overlapped another play structure and less than the required use zone.
